subject: D-INTEG-01 COMMITTED_CORRUPT observable
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 FEM observables for ASTRA
STATUS: CANDIDATE
OBSERVABLE: COMMITTED_CORRUPT (recover_state=3) when dest COMMIT magic and dest CRC invalid
ASTRA: D does not emit status. Integrity-class mapping is B-owned (same family as invalid_count>0 -> DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL / 0x55). Recommend not UNKNOWN, not ANSWER, not roll-forward.
INDEX=1 must not upgrade CORRUPT to COMMITTED_NEW.
SPEAR invalid_count / tie_overflow still N/A if SPEAR not invoked; D does not remap to UNKNOWN.
QSTAR: reward_accepted remains external (reward source + pending identity). D will not credit without it.
NOT_CLAIMED: FEM_PERSIST_PASS FE256_256_256_PASS BOARD_PASS
PROGRAM=NO
